name: Death by Chocolate Chocobar
ingredients_raw: Medium Fat Ice Cream (75%): Water, Milk Solids (Cow), Sweeteners Blend [Maltitol, Stevia (Steviol Glycoside]]. Dietary Fiber (Oligofructose), Cocoa Solids 4.3% {501(i)), Stabilizers (410, 412), Emulsifiers (471, 477), Natural Flavoring Substance (Vanilla). Outer Chocodip Coating (25%): Sweeteners (Maltitol), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil, Palm Kernel Oil), Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Mass, Emulsifiers [322(i), 476]. Nature Identical Flavoring Substance (Vanillin), Edible Vegetable Oil (Coconut). Allergen: Contains Milk & Soy.
